name: Iris Yin
description: Iris Yin studies Statistics and Machine Learning at Carnegie Mellon, with a minor in Human-Computer Interaction. Her portfolio covers machine learning, speech and HCI work.
tagline: Statistics & Machine Learning at Carnegie Mellon, minor in Human-Computer Interaction.
intro: Hi, I’m Iris. I build AI systems, from speech models to tools people use every day. Off the keyboard, I practice Chinese calligraphy, make art, and dance.
about: I’m a junior at Carnegie Mellon (graduating May 2028), studying Statistics and Machine Learning with a minor in Human-Computer Interaction.

My work splits between those two fields. At Poseidon.ai I fine-tuned speech models and built retrieval agents. In the HCII Spud Lab I build an iOS app for a behavioral study and code interview transcripts to understand how people build security habits. I want a model’s numbers to hold up, and I want the people using it to be able to make sense of what it produces.
